test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Six friends, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a circle facing the center but not in the same order. B and E are not immediate neighbours of each other. B is sitting second to the right of A. C is not an immediate neighbour A. Only two people sit between D and A.

What is the sitting position of F?

options.text: Immediate neighbour of both A and C
Second to the left of A
Third to the right of C

solution:
**Given:**

Number of friends = 6

Name of friends = A, B, C, D, E and F

**Solution:**

 
• B is sitting second to the right of A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b31073bbfa9f3bbe64d6792d956ae084b9d2e72ff93c17255fd63592a5c71e48.png] 

 
• Only two people sit between D and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3a02966c6bbbb92de45d197a2012534bcc86808ed86973f06c4bc95c3d7f80e.png] 

 
• C is not an immediate neighbour A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8db5be07d8ee3bdc3b242d2a2a6064c13c4c89de10bcf7b6f87b3e978c901e0.png] ​

 
• B and E are not immediate neighbours of each other. So, B and F are neighbours of each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/371cb7330e669ce8e9ac301051382abde0d19be926d38fd0da56a52f921aed42.png] ​

So, ***F is third to the right to C.***

Hence, "**Third to the right of C"** is the correct answer.

b8
